## Standing operator rules
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Run `avatar-cdn-batched-migration` in between other work. Steps must run in order, one at a time.
- can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing Stripe customer webhooks to return 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Pagination work was dropped/superseded; invoice PDF work is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- CI integration label: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded because that pool is retired and hangs.
- Production database: `app_production`.
- Avatar source/manifest: `/srv/app/avatars`; `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`.
- CDN: `s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/`.
- Migration run ID: `gen_random_uuid()`.
- First SQL batch: `sql/update_avatar_batch_0001.sql`.
- Archive: `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`.
- Renderer: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`; `render_invoice()` delegates to `_format_lines()`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Adding `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index: doubled ingest-path write latency.

## Plan and progress
- Stripe webhook signature fix: pending inspection; next command: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
- SQLAlchemy modernization: in progress; `DeclarativeBase` migration in `ledgerly/models.py` done, tests pending.
- Avatar migration steps 1–5 done; steps 6–8 pending, but exact step 6 command was not preserved—status unknown.
- Release notes and staging smoke test remain pending; notes must be posted first.

## Recent work
PDF fixes passed `14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing passed `83 passed, 4 skipped`. Full baseline was `148 passed, 2 skipped`. Began SQLAlchemy cleanup by replacing function-based `declarative_base()` with `DeclarativeBase`. Stripe investigation has not yet begun.
